title: Group Retiree Premium Rate Schedule: Monthly Premium, Default Retiree Contribution and Default Sponsor Share
content:
Scheduled below for each plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans, in USD per enrolled retiree per month: the total premium the plan charges the group, the share billed to the retiree where the sponsor sets none, and the share the sponsor pays where the group contract sets none. The calendar day of the coverage month on which the retiree's contribution falls due, which is a calendar day between day 1 and day 28, is scheduled with them.

## Monthly rates per enrolled retiree

| Group plan | Total group premium | Default retiree contribution | Default sponsor share | Contribution due day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | 218.40 | 62.00 | 156.40 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | 276.90 | 78.00 | 198.90 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | 341.50 | 96.00 | 245.50 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | 64.20 | 18.00 | 46.20 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | 88.70 | 26.00 | 62.70 | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | 117.30 | 34.00 | 83.30 | 1 |

## Reading of the schedule

Taken the other way round, on every plan of the book the default sponsor share and the default retiree contribution together make the total group premium: on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO), 156.40 together with 62.00 makes 218.40, and on Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP), 83.30 together with 34.00 makes 117.30.

The due day stands at the first day of the coverage month on every plan in this book, so no plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans falls due later in its coverage month than any other.

The two default shares are what the schedule provides where the sponsor or the group contract sets none of its own; the amount actually held against a retiree's enrollment is the monthly share as that sponsor set it.
